description: Multi-pass extraction Pass 4: Damages & Expenses - PROCESSING setting

system_messages.content:
Extract ONLY financial/damage facts:

1. MEDICAL_EXPENSES: Dollar amounts for medical costs (COST_AMOUNT)
   - Include exact amounts: '$28,000', '$14,250', 'approximately $18,000'
   - Preserve qualifiers: 'exceed', 'approximately', 'believed to be'

2. PROPERTY_DAMAGE: Vehicle repair costs, total loss status
   - COST_AMOUNT: dollar amounts for repairs
   - WAS_TOTAL_LOSS: if vehicle was totaled
   - Include repair vs replacement distinction

3. TREATMENT_TIMELINE: Medical treatment details
   - STARTED_ON: when treatment began
   - ENDED_ON: when treatment ended  
   - HAD_SESSION_COUNT: number of therapy/treatment sessions

For amounts, preserve exact text including qualifiers.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
{"nodes": [
  {
    "node_type": "STATED_FACT",
    "id": "STATED_FACT_0",
    "text": "<fact statement>",
    "fact_category": "<MEDICAL_EXPENSES|PROPERTY_DAMAGE|TREATMENT_TIMELINE>",
    "value_raw": "<exact text including qualifiers>",
    "assertion_triple": "{\"subject\": \"<person/item>\", \"relationship\": \"<PREDICATE>\", \"object\": \"<value>\"}",
    "certainty": "0.95",
    "temporal_context": "current_incident",
    "is_denial": false,
    "is_boilerplate": false,
    "temporal_validity": "{\"t_valid_from\": null, \"t_valid_until\": null}",
    "metadata": "{}"
  }
], "edges": []}

PREDICATES FOR THIS PASS:
- COST_AMOUNT (dollar amounts for medical or property)
- WAS_TOTAL_LOSS (vehicle was totaled)
- WAS_REPAIRABLE (vehicle was repaired)
- STARTED_ON (treatment start date)
- ENDED_ON (treatment end date)
- HAD_SESSION_COUNT (number of treatment sessions)

EXAMPLE:
Input: "Plaintiff's medical expenses are believed to exceed $28,000. Prior medical records indicate expenses of approximately $18,000. Her vehicle was declared a total loss with an estimated value of $12,000.

Plaintiff began physical therapy on March 8, 2023 and completed 12 sessions over 6 weeks, ending on April 19, 2023. The incident report states medical costs of $14,250 and vehicle repairs of $7,400."

The total loss ($12,000) vs repairs ($7,400) may also indicate conflicting accounts.
